page.notes: The page carries no printed text of its own. The large mirrored lines at the top ("DE SACRA / SCRIPTVRA", the lines below them, and the mirrored lines near the foot) are show-through from the title page on the reverse, so they are not transcribed. The oval library stamp "Pfälzische Landesbibliothek Speyer a. Rh." and the handwritten marks ("Rara", the shelf number and the pencilled numbers near the foot) are not printed text and are left out. The brown water or foxing stains are not text. A strip of the neighbouring page is visible at the right edge and is not transcribed.
